system_overview: This specification provides formal machine-checked proofs of the safety and liveness properties of a grow-only counter CRDT (Conflict-free Replicated Data Type). It extends the base CRDT specification and proves type correctness, the safety invariant (each node knows its own counter best), monotonicity (counter values never decrease), and convergence (all nodes eventually agree) using the TLA+ Proof System.
actors_and_components: Same as the base grow-only counter CRDT: a set of distributed nodes that maintain local views of all counter values. This module adds no new system components but introduces proof-related auxiliary definitions including a summation operator over node-indexed vectors and a termination measure tracking the total distance between nodes' views.
state_variables: Inherits all state variables from the base CRDT specification. No additional state variables are introduced. The module defines auxiliary proof constructs: a summation operator for vectors indexed by the set of nodes, a distance function measuring how far each node's view is from the true counter values, and an aggregate termination measure summing all distances.
initial_state: Same as the base CRDT specification: all counter values are zero across all nodes' views.
actions: Inherits all actions from the base CRDT specification (increment and gossip) without modification. The proofs analyze how these actions interact with the termination measure, showing that gossip never increases the measure and non-stuttering gossip strictly decreases it.
safety_properties: The module proves three safety properties: (1) Type correctness: all counter values remain natural numbers in the expected structure. (2) Safety: each node always has the most up-to-date view of its own counter value, at least as large as any other node's view. (3) Monotonicity: counter values never decrease across state transitions.
liveness_properties: The module proves convergence: under the fairness assumptions (weak fairness on gossip and eventually only gossip actions), all nodes eventually reach identical counter vectors. The proof proceeds by showing that a termination measure (total distance between nodes' views and true values) is a natural number that strictly decreases with each non-stuttering gossip step and equals zero exactly when all nodes agree.
model_bounds: The set of nodes is assumed to be a finite set. No specific numeric bounds are given as this is a proof module, not a model-checking configuration.
additional_assumptions: The proofs rely on four lemmas about the summation operator that are stated without proof (proof omitted): that sums of natural-number vectors yield natural numbers, that a sum is zero if and only if all entries are zero, that pointwise-smaller vectors have smaller or equal sums, and that strictly smaller at one point implies strictly smaller sum. The module assumes the set of nodes is finite. The convergence proof is structured as a well-founded induction on the termination measure.
